headlines.description: — Alex Tuch had a goal and an assist, and the Buffalo Sabres held on to beat the Vancouver Canucks 5-3 on Tuesday night for their 11th win in 12 games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tuch has goal and assist as Sabres beat Canucks 5-3 for 11th win in 12 games

events.name: Colorado Avalanche at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Brandon Hagel snapped a third-period tie with his 20th goal of the season to lead the Tampa Bay Lightning to their eighth consecutive win with a 4-2 victory over the Colorado Avalanche on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brandon Hagel scores winner as Lightning beat Avalanche 4-2

headlines.description: — Trevor Zegras scored twice for the Philadelphia Flyers in his first game against his former Anaheim team to lead them to a 5-2 win over the Ducks on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevor Zegras scores twice against former team as Flyers defeat Gauthier, Ducks 5-2

headlines.description: — K'Andre Miller scored twice while Andrei Svechnikov had four assists as the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Dallas Stars 6-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Miller, Svechnikov, Stankoven stand out in Hurricanes' win against Stars, Rantanen

events.name: New Jersey Devils at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Anthony Duclair recorded a hat trick for the first time in more than six years, Ilya Sorokin stopped all 44 shots he faced in his return from injury and the New York Islanders handed the New Jersey Devils a second consecutive defeat, routing them...
headlines.shortLinkText: Anthony Duclair has a hat trick and two assists as the Islanders rout the Devils 9-0

events.name: Florida Panthers at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Matthew Knies scored a goal and set up Auston Matthews to push the Toronto Maple Leafs to a 4-1 win against the defending Stanley Cup champion Florida Panthers on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Leafs, Matthews pounce on Panthers for 4-1 win

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Winnipeg Jets

headlines.description: — Tomas Hertl scored on the power play at 4:47 of overtime and the Vegas Golden Knights beat Winnipeg 4-3 on Tuesday night, handing the Jets their 10th straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tomas Hertl scores in OT as Golden Knights win 4-3, hand Jets their 10th straight loss

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid scored three goals, including one on a penalty shot, and Leon Draisaitl had a goal and two assists as the Edmonton Oilers beat the Nashville Predators 6-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor McDavid has hat trick as Oilers beat Predators 6-2

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Alex Wennberg had a goal and an assist against his former team, and the San Jose Sharks bounced back from a frustrating loss three days earlier and beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 5-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wennberg has goal and assist against former team as Sharks beat Blue Jackets 5-2

headlines.description: — Kaapo Kakko had two goals and an assist, Berkly Catton scored his first two NHL goals, and the Seattle Kraken beat the Boston Bruins 7-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kakko, Catton score 2 goals each as Kraken beat Bruins 7-4 to extend point streak to 8-0-1
